verdict.rationale: CIPO's own trademarks page lists "Apply for/amend a trademark" in an Online services block alongside filing-system pages. Its patents page offers a "Log in to MyCIPO Patents" account entry with filing, maintenance-fee, and electronic-correspondence pages beside it, so the core filing transaction is published as an online service. The evidence is mostly link titles, though: missing for 10: explicit confirmation that patent filing and fee payment are completed end-to-end online, detail on the online filing flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
